prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 课程表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "节次" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 92px
  col 3: header "周一" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "周二" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "周三" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 6: header "周四" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 7: header "周五" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 169px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周各节课的时间和课程，方便查看每日安排及比较同一时段的课程。","reading":"读者可以沿行查看某一节课在各工作日的安排，也可以沿列查看某一天的课程；节次和时间共同定位每一行。","groups":["节次、时间：共同标识课程所在的时段。","周一至周五：承担相同的课程安排功能，应便于横向比较；周一和周五有较长课程名称。"],"keep_intact":["节次数字","时间中的单个时刻，如08:00和08:45","课程名称应保持字序完整，不截断"],"may_wrap":["较长的课程名称可按中文阅读习惯换行","时间范围可在连接符附近换行；同一行较长课程名称产生的行高可容纳时间换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [52, 113, 39, 38, 38, 38, 41] · table 360×660px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 269, 60, 153] · column headers wrapped 5/7 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [37, 70, 49, 49, 49, 49, 50] · table 354×707px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 269, 60, 153] · column headers wrapped 6/7 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 2
Design r0C: widths [37, 70, 64, 37, 37, 37, 74] · table 357×474px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 106, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 2
Constraint adjustments applied: r0B: raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 360px to fit 359px
r0C: raised a column to the minimum 38px; raised a column to the minimum 38px; raised a column to the minimum 38px; raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 363px to fit 359px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"节次和时间表头完整，时间范围保持单行，时段定位清楚。","problems":"五个星期表头及大量普通课程名竖向断行；周五长课程占据极高的单元格，拉大整行，削弱横向比较。周一长课程也形成很高的末行。","cause":"时间列宽113px，足以容纳完整时间范围，但占用过多宽度；五个星期列仅38–41px，内容区只能容纳约一个汉字。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"五个星期列宽度接近，体现了它们相同的功能；时间列比r0A更节省空间。","problems":"节次和星期表头仍然换行，普通课程名称也多为逐字竖排；周五长课程和周一末行仍然很高。前两行时间范围被拆成三行，行内比较不够紧凑。","cause":"星期列为49–50px，扣除21px后不足以容纳两个汉字；时间列70px的内容区为49px，略小于单个时刻所需的50px。节次列37px也不足以容纳完整表头。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"周一和周五得到更多空间，长课程名称可按词序换行，显著降低了长课程所在行的高度；周一、周五的表头及普通课程名称也更易读。","problems":"节次、周二至周四的表头和课程名称仍逐字换行，星期列之间的宽度落差明显；前两行时间被拆成三行，浪费了部分长课程节省出的高度。","cause":"周一64px、周五74px改善了长内容，但周二至周四仅37px；时间列70px的内容区比单个时刻所需宽度少1px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"均衡微调","widths":[38,71,52,46,46,46,60],"change":"以r0C为基础，将时间列增至71px以容纳单个时刻；周一保留两个汉字的宽度，周五获得额外空间，其余三天等宽。尝试在长课程换行与星期列节奏之间取得平衡。"},{"name":"两列完整","widths":[38,71,52,52,38,38,70],"change":"让周一、周二的两字表头和普通课程保持完整，周五保留较宽的长课程区；周三、周四使用窄列，检验更多完整短名称是否值得接受星期列的不均匀。"},{"name":"优先周五","widths":[38,71,53,38,38,38,83],"change":"进一步扩宽周五，减轻最长课程对整行高度的影响；周一仍容纳两个汉字，时间列容纳单个时刻。用于比较长课程可读性与三个窄星期列之间的取舍。"}]}
